matches.canonical_construct: GNPTAB encodes the alpha and beta subunits of N-acetylglucosamine-1-phosphotransferase, which initiates synthesis of the mannose-6-phosphate recognition marker on lysosomal hydrolases in the Golgi. Severe loss causes mucolipidosis II alpha/beta with failure of lysosomal enzyme targeting and extracellular mis-secretion of hydrolases.
matches.canonical_vignette: An infant has coarse facial features, severe growth failure, joint contractures, and radiographic dysostosis multiplex. Plasma activities of several lysosomal hydrolases are markedly elevated, while cultured fibroblasts have reduced intracellular lysosomal enzyme activity. Genetic testing identifies biallelic loss-of-function variants in GNPTAB.
matches.canonical_lead_in: Which cellular process is most directly defective?

canonical_options.A: Acidification of lysosomes by the vacuolar hydrogen ATPase
canonical_options.B: Endocytosis of LDL particles through the LDL receptor
canonical_options.C: Ubiquitination of cytosolic proteins for proteasomal degradation
canonical_options.D: Generation of mannose-6-phosphate recognition markers that target lysosomal enzymes from the Golgi to lysosomes

matches.canonical_vignette: A 27-year-old man has recurrent episodes of confusion after carbohydrate-rich meals. During an episode, plasma ammonia and citrulline are markedly elevated. canonical_options.D: Import of pyruvate from the cytosol into the mitochondrial matrix
